descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Transport, logistică, lanț de aprovizionare și depozitare
Responsabilities:
Development and adaptation of ITSM and ESM processe 
Creation and maintenance of workflows/scripts, automations (e.g. BPMN processes) and business rules 
Development of interfaces and integrations with third-party systems 
Analysis and optimization of existing data models and database structures
Support with release and deployment processes 
Error analysis and troubleshooting at application and database level 
Creation and maintenance of technical documentation
Participation in projects to further develop the service management landscape
Support with the administration and configuration of the ITSM platform 
 Requirements:
Very good programming skills in at least one scripting or programming language (e.g., Python, Jython, JavaScript, Java, or C#)
Several years of experience in the development/customization of ITSM/ESM systems (or similar systems) 
Good knowledge of relational databases (preferably Microsoft SQL Server)
Experience with modeling processes using BPMN v2
Experience with SQL, data modeling, and data analysis
Experience with REST APIs, web services, or other integration technologies 
Basic knowledge of key ITIL practices based on IT Service Management V4 (ITIL v4)
